_comment: yabo's Internet Archive curation seed (the L2 'repack' source; IA = core, same fetch->extract->launch loop as GitHub releases). TWO kinds of entries: 'uploaders' = curated repackers whose whole catalog yabo indexes via IA search (resolve @handle -> uploads with the official `internetarchive` python lib); 'items' = specific owner/user-pinned IA items (the 'users can add their own IA links' path). Same curation pattern as favorite-artists.json: the load-bearing part is trusting good repacks, not the plumbing. 2026-09-25: 'produces' = PcRepack | Rom | GameData | EmuBundle (what the account's items are, decides where they land); 'handles' = every IA account the same person uses, Seen is shared across them; 'titleExclude' = substring that drops noise items.

Owner-vouched 2026-09-25, rohan's friend, one person with two accounts (tirednonfire mirrors three of the same items). 48 + 3 items, ~540 GB, all since June 2026: RPCS3 + game bundles preconfigured (Uncharted 2, GoW Ascension, Demon's Souls, Killzone 2 and Resistance with online revived, Infamous 1/2, Ratchet Future, Modnation, Motorstorm), shadPS4 bundles (Godzilla), PCSX2 Sly 1, Skate 3 Recompiled. Produces=EmuBundle is a NEW kind: install = extract, play = the emulator exe inside the bundle with the game as argument. Do not subscribe until the C# ArtifactKind has it, or every item imports as a broken PC repack. Email not exposed: the uploads list comes from the profile search backend by handle (services/search/beta/page_production, page_type=account_details, page_target=@handle).
